reasoning: This repository is an E2E test suite and examples collection for distributed workloads on RHOAI. It contains Go-based integration test suites (tests/kfto, tests/trainer, tests/fms, tests/odh), training examples (Ray, KFTO, etc.), container image definitions (runtime and test images), and benchmarks. It does not implement an operator (no controllers or reconciliation loops), is not a library meant for import by other projects, does not run as a service, and is not pure configuration. It is best described as a QE/testing repository with supplementary training examples and container image definitions.
